run_boost_build_loop_test: run the BoostBuild test that detects recursion in circular target references between main and l libraries
test_circular_dependency_detection: test that the build system reports an error when lib main depends on lib l which depends back on main
write_jamroot_with_circular_deps: write a jamroot.jam file that defines two libraries with circular dependencies to trigger a recursion error
run_build_system_with_expected_failure: run the build system with --no-error-backtrace flag expecting a non-zero exit status due to circular references
verify_recursion_error_message: verify the build system stdout contains the expected recursion error message about target references
